title: AI‑Agent Surge and Custom Silicon: How Cloud Giants Redefine Services in 2026
core_insight: AI‑agent平台与定制硅芯片（如Azure Cobalt 200）的深度融合正重塑云服务，推动AI‑云一体化和行业专属高性能计算的结构性变革。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出ECS Gateway简化容器Ingress，增强K8s/ECS网络管理；AWS Emulator提供本地全栈服务仿真，提升开发者调试效率；持续在AI/ML层面发布GPT‑6.1 on Bedrock、Polly生成式引擎等，显示AI与云服务深度融合的渐进趋势。Google Cloud推出AI加速器专用存储以及在BigQuery和Looker中的AI代理可观测性治理，提升AI工作负载的原生集成深度；Azure expands AI agent capabilities via the Foundry Copilot harness and a multimodal AI platform; Cloudflare open‑sources the Kitesurf AI‑agent browser engine; Volcengine adds ByteHouse cloud data‑warehouse, boosting real‑time analytics。 Amazon S3 Tables加入对Apache Iceberg的托管迁移功能，标志对象存储与湖仓技术的进一步融合，提升大数据治理能力；AWS Continuum利用AI自动检测代码漏洞，强化安全基础设施。Google在2026 Gartner MQ中获运营数据库领袖称号，发布逆向ETL从BigQuery到AlloyDB的原生导出，强化数据流动性；Azure introduces Cobalt 200 VMs with custom silicon for EDA workloads and HSM hardware audit logging; Cloudflare launches Spend Management for Workers and experiments with the QuePaxa consensus algorithm; Volcengine releases four new data products (DataLeap, ByteHouse, lake‑warehouse, E‑MapReduce)。 Amazon S3 Tables now offer managed migration of Apache Hive tables to Apache Iceberg Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more Beyond the compute bottleneck: Maximizing the ROI of AI accelerators with purpose-built storage
